methods.name: Partial fractions
methods.summary: Split a rational function into simpler fractions that integrate directly.

subskills.name: Factor the denominator
subskills.description: Factor the denominator into linear and irreducible quadratic factors.

subskills.name: Set up the decomposition
subskills.description: Write one term with an unknown constant for each factor.

subskills.name: Solve for the constants
subskills.description: Find the unknown constants and integrate each term.
